Audio.description: Concepts and workflows for digital audio processing, including multi-channel setups, frequency domain tools, and plugin integration.

Colors.description: Guides on managing the visual appearance of your patches with palettes, themes, and styles.

Data.description: Techniques for handling and manipulating data structures like arrays, dictionaries, numbers, and strings.

Debugging.description: Tools and strategies for troubleshooting patches, understanding error messages, and analyzing data flow.

Files.description: Understanding file management, supported formats, and how Max locates dependencies via the search path.

Gen.description: In-depth guides on using Gen for low-level audio and data processing, covering operators and expressions.

Jitter.description: Concepts for working with matrix data, video engines, graphics processing, and 3D geometry in Jitter.

Max Interface.description: Navigating and customizing the Max authoring environment, toolbars, and inspection windows.

MIDI.description: Handling MIDI protocols, mapping, and routing within the Max environment.

Parameters.description: Managing application state, presets, parameter interpolation, and OSC integration.

Patching.description: Fundamental mechanics of creating, connecting, and lifecycle management of Max objects.

Reuse and Organization.description: Strategies for modular patching, including abstractions, bpatchers, externals, and project management.

Scripting.description: Utilizing external scripts (JavaScript, Lua) and textual workflows to automate and extend Max.

Sharing.description: Methods for distributing your work, including Max Projects, Standalones, and Collectives.

Timing.description: Managing scheduling, transport controls, and time value syntax across your patches.

Max For Live.description: Integrating Max within Ableton Live, creating devices, and managing automation and the Live API.

Live Object Model.description: Use Max objects like live.object and live.path to read and modify the state of Ableton Live from within a Max for Live device. Also accessible from the JavaScript API.

series.title: Polish Your Pixels
series.description: In the world of digital rendering, attention to detail can make all the difference between a decent image and a breathtaking one. This guide is designed to help you bridge that gap and elevate your visual output. In the following paragraphs we will explore a range of strategies, tools, and techniques to fine-tune every aspect of your render, from realistic lighting and advanced material setups to subtle post-processing enhancements. Whether you're a beginner looking to improve or an experienced user aiming to perfect your craft, this article will equip you with the insights needed to achieve high-quality renders in Jitter.
